career_ladder.note: Subordinate judicial appointments in Gujarat follow the Gujarat State Judicial Service Rules, 2005 under the administrative superintendence of the High Court of Gujarat, with revised pay scales governed by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC).

exam_scheme.note: Direct recruitment examination conducted by the High Court of Gujarat consisting of Preliminary Elimination Examination (OMR), Main Written Examination (Descriptive), and Viva-voce Test (Oral Interview).

stages.source_label: High Court of Gujarat Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment of Civil Judges

papers.paper_name: Paper I: Criminal Law (Part A), Civil Law (Part B), General Knowledge, English, Reasoning & Computer (Part C)
Paper II: Test of Gujarati Language (Grammar, Essay, Translation, Comprehension)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% marks (mandatory for candidates without Higher Level Gujarati at 10th/12th)

stages.source_label: High Court of Gujarat Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment of Civil Judges

papers.paper_name: Paper I: Criminal Law (IPC, CrPC, Evidence Act, Prohibition Act, POCSO, DV Act, etc.)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in each paper and 50% aggregate (45% for SC/ST)

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Civil Law (CPC, Limitation, Contract, Constitution, Specific Relief, Court Fees, TPA, etc.)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in each paper and 50% aggregate (45% for SC/ST)

stages.source_label: High Court of Gujarat Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment of Civil Judges

papers.paper_name: Board Viva-voce / Personality & Legal Acumen Test (High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% marks required in Viva-voce to be eligible for final select list

financial_package.note: Judicial officers in Gujarat receive salary packages governed by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) as implemented under orders of the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India.
financial_package.pay_source_label: High Court of Gujarat Notification & The Gujarat State Judicial Service Rules, 2005 (as amended; Second National Judicial Pay Commission Pay Scale ₹77,840 – ₹1,36,520)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculations based on SNJPC Level J-1 entry basic pay of ₹77,840 with 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025), judicial HRA / rent-free government accommodation, sumptuary allowance, robe allowance, and fuel allowance minus standard NPS deductions.
official_perks: Rent-free official judicial accommodation / bungalow with maintenance
Official staff vehicle or monthly conveyance allowance with fuel entitlement
Sumptuary allowance and robe allowance as mandated by SNJPC
Comprehensive medical facility and reimbursement for officer and family
Electricity and water subsidy, telephone/broadband reimbursement
Home orderly / domestic attendant allowance as per High Court rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and judicial training programmes

competition_benchmarks.note: Official notifications and qualified lists published by the Recruitment Cell, High Court of Gujarat.
